basic_info.description: Storybook Charm in the heart of prestigious Lakeside! This enchanting detached home features modern conveniences amidst timeless 1930's details. Generously-sized living room has windows on 2 sides. Welcoming kitchen flows seamlessly into the formal dining room with convenient access to both the rear and side yards. A gracious staircase takes you to an upper level with 2 large bedrooms each with French doors opening to its own private balcony! On the main level there is a sunny 3rd bedroom while downstairs there is a spacious family room featuring a fireplace. Enjoy interior access to the spacious 1-car garage with laundry and ample storage. Additional parking in the driveway. This split-level corner home with great southwest exposure is located on an exceptionally beautiful and peaceful block of Rossmoor Drive. Close to Stonestown, Lake Merced, Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, Merced Library and West Portal shopping with easy access to MUNI and I-280.
